changes: Night Light: an opt-in ambient white point that follows the ambient light sensor's colour temperature (iio-sensor-proxy's ColorTemperature), the same patch as alarm-aurora's kwin-aurora and fedora-aurora's kwin.
notes: alarm-aurora also carries upstream c9d72079 (no crash on a scanout device without a render device). It fixes a regression from 6783f9610c, which moved the cross-GPU direct scanout check into the compositor in 6.8; 6.7.4 still checks in backends/drm/drm_egl_layer.cpp with the null check, so the fix is not needed here.
